wasmboy.wasm.iife.js is WasmBoy 0.7.1 by Aaron Turner (torch2424), with one small patch (below).
Source and license (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/torch2424/wasmBoy
One change: its IndexedDB store falls back to memory when the browser blocks storage.
It is used only to run the game in a web browser; the game itself is not part of WasmBoy.
